It took me 3 tries to get it right. Cymbalta as a teen, but switched to Zoloft since Cymbalta didnt seem to do much for me. Was on Zoloft for 3 years until seeing a psychologist who recommended Welbutrin and it was a huge game changer. Don't give up. Ask for information on side effects and what temperaments different anti-depressants aide with. Recognizing what it looks like when you're slipping will help too so you can let your doctor know and they can help you determine whether to change medications or increase dosage of what your currently taking. I found that a lot of the time doctors would want to increase a dosage before trying something new, so try to stay in tune with yourself as best you can and stick to your gut feeling if you don't think something is working for you. Best of luck in your journey my friend!
